scope: Seven explicit contextual adaptations, not approval of the full corpus.

make_happy.sentence: Matt's mom promised a surprise for him after school.
make_happy.review_note: Abstracts a mother promising a surprise; does not prescribe an outcome.

trusted_help.sentence: He called his parents for help.
trusted_help.context: Fred and his friends were playing in a tree.|They thought it would be fun to climb it.|Yet when they climbed it Fred fell out.|He hurt his knee.
trusted_help.adapted_text: Ask someone they trust for help
trusted_help.review_note: Abstracts asking parents for help after an injury; no injury is imported.

help_friend.annotation: a trusting friend to come to his aid
help_friend.sentence: A friend urgently needed him, and Steve jumped in his car to go help.
help_friend.context: On a very hot day, Steve was outside with his dog when his phone rang.
help_friend.adapted_text: Be there for a friend who needs them
help_friend.review_note: Keeps the idea of helping a friend, without importing the car or urgency.

rest.review_note: Keeps a rest-related motivation in its original context.

companionship.annotation: wanted to be with my friend
companionship.sentence: Meghan and I went to the beach one time.
companionship.review_note: Abstracts companionship without importing the beach.

belonging.sentence: Then Cole realized that his classmates were all friends from Pre-K.
belonging.context: Cole was excited about his first day of kindergarten.|But he was nervous that nobody would like him.|He feared he wouldn't make any friends at all.
belonging.review_note: Abstracts a school belonging motivation without imposing a school setting.

support_success.sentence: Alan was the coach of a little league baseball team.
support_success.review_note: Abstracts a coach motivation without importing a sports setting.
